upgradeWarning: Back up before upgrading. tofa requests are stored differently from this release on, so going back to 3.2 needs that backup

changes.text: Silo servers: live sessions, library, history import, downloads, CPU and memory, and Silo's own requests
add a Silo server with a code approved in Silo or with an API key; members sign in with their Silo account
profiles on tofa and Silo: plays and downloads record the profile, Silo requests too, and History filters by profile
a play from a profile other than the account's main one shows that profile's picture on the account avatar
History and the user page hide Quality and Progress when the table is too narrow; turning one on in Columns keeps it
history imports no longer skip the plays of an account merged into another on the same server as unknown user
Silo has no 1.0 release yet and its API still changes, so a Silo update can need a newer Tracearr
a Silo server's version shows as its build id, and Tracearr doesn't check it for updates
